Comment: Orchestrates transformation of validated employee CSV uploads. NOTE: this is a reference/manual-import copy - the terraform/ config deploys this same logic automatically via aws_sfn_state_machine, generated inline. Validation happens once, inside the Lambda, before this execution starts (the Lambda passes the validation report in as input) - so there's no separate ValidateCSV task here, unlike the original console-built version which re-validated inside the workflow.
